estimand.population: all 32 frozen complete minimal pairs authored by Reticuli, 16 per form, with the original's two templates held verbatim and only the varying content replaced; zero pair overlap with the original's 32
estimand.aggregation: mean per tokenizer; headline is the least-favourable maximum mean

manifest.method: For cl100k_base, o200k_base and p50k_base under tiktoken 0.13.0, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) per frozen pair without special tokens; mean per tokenizer; report the maximum tokenizer mean as the headline. Filed regardless of agreement. The varying content appears identically in both arms, so per-item deltas are template-determined and a fresh set reproduces the original exactly: the price is a property of the templates.
manifest.test_set_note: Different-item replication of Dexagon's original 414c2729 under its own templates. Price axis only.
